text: Another busy day at Éternité begins! The café looks a little different from an employee's perspective—the usually relaxing and comfortable environment becomes now very busy... with flying omelet rice and dashing cats!

Sure enough, as soon as I enter the kitchen I see Ichihime locked in a pitched battle with eggs and whisk. I don't know why, but recently she's been super keen on baking and impossible to tear away from the kitchen. Well, in that case, should I tell Usumi Ishihara that we might have a new candidate for the pastry club?
In contrast to the frenetic atmosphere of the café, today A-37 seems a little bit distracted, sitting in a corner and staring at a packed lunch. I poke Reina and ask if she knows what's up.

It is surprising that such a thing could happen to the usually very proactive A-37! As I walk over to him, I remember that he didn't like people coming up behind him, so I intentionally circled around to the front.
I lean over and take a look at the items: two bottles of Éternité sparkling orange. While it tastes pretty good, not many people actually order it in a place that specializes in coffee.
The address on the label reads Lotus Gardens. If I remember correctly, this is an upscale neighborhood nearby, home to the rich and famous...

Maybe some of A-37's caution has rubbed off on me, but I suddenly find it a bit weird that someone in such a prestigious neighborhood would order just two bottles of sparkling orange from a local café.
I open the map app on my phone and check the route, and the address isn't too far from the café. Maybe...
{character:Ichihime} Nyaa, Nyaaaaa, NYAAA! Horrible eggs! Taste my Shell Shatterer!
{character:Reina Nanami} Don't forget to pick out the pieces of eggshell, Ichihime!
{character:player} What happened, Boss?
{character:Reina Nanami} What do you mean?
{character:player} A-37. It's just so rare to see him in a daze.
{character:Reina Nanami} I don't really know what's going on with him either. Mr. A is usually responsible for delivery orders, but he just fell silent when he saw that order today, no idea why.
{character:player} Is there a problem with this order?
{character:A-37} Problem? You could say that.
Cheer up A-37, and encourage him to make the delivery.
Help A-37 out by making this delivery yourself.

Saturne's expression seems sincere, but we have never met before, after all, and... Before I'd left, A-37 warned me that this place was not safe. While I can't put my finger on what exactly isn't safe, I have no reason to disbelieve him.

Remembering my doubts from earlier, wouldn't accepting the invitation be the best opportunity to get to the bottom of it all? Saturne's invitation really does seem sincere, too, which also makes it difficult to decline.

Even though it's baking hot today, the delivery address wasn't too far from the café. It shouldn't take A-37 long to get back, especially at his pace. What's more, A-37 needs to realize that, as employees, we can't pick and choose our work. If the boss gives an order, there are only two options for us "get it done" and "try to get it done".
Ichihime
Reina Nanami
player
A-37 hesitated momentarily, which is quite rare for him, before looking me up and down and finally nodding.
He catches up with me after I have collected the items for delivery, apparently having thought of something else.

For some reason, A-37's serious expression makes me think of parents dropping their children off at school. I have to successfully deliver this order and prove myself to him. After all, I, too, have been hustling in One Han City for a long time.

Lotus Gardens is surrounded on all sides by verdant green spaces, making it an oasis of calm in the middle of the hustle and bustle of the city. Entering it is like being transported to a different world, where none of the noise of the nearby commercial area could be heard.
All the residences here are large, detached houses, which makes my destination easy to find. I follow the directions easily, eventually stopping in front of one particular building.

After pressing the doorbell, I'm greeted not with the usual "ding-dong", but the soft tinkle of a bell. The house owner clearly isn't far away, as the bell has barely fallen silent when the metal door—complete with intricate carvings— is opened, and a well-dressed, middle-aged man with silver hair appears. He stands in the doorway and looks me up and down.
I greet him politely, after double-checking the name on the order—Saturne.

The man's gaze holds a trace of suspicion. I quickly look down, remembering that I'd changed out of my uniform and into something short-sleeved and informal, given the blistering heat. It isn't at all surprising that this gentleman doesn't realize I'm from Éternité.
Saturne seems an amiable man, thanking me and taking the delivery before giving it a quick look with a satisfied expression.
I'm surprised that Saturne knows A-37, but then I remember his reaction. Could something unpleasant have happened during a previous delivery? Either way, I'd better cover for him.
Seeming to sense my doubts, Saturne's face becomes apologetic.
I'm a bit hesitant about accepting Saturne's invitation...
Regardless, common courtesy is the least I can do. I nod, agreeing to Saturne's "next time" invitation.
After getting back to the café, I recall Saturne's reaction. Had A-37 often made deliveries there before? Pondering this, I decide to ask Reina.

I am totally surprised by Reina Nanami's answer. I honestly thought Saturne had asked about A-37 because he often made the deliveries. But it now seems that wasn't the case. Did they know each other from before?
It's a shame that A-37 is a very private person. I'll try to ask him about this when he might feel more inclined to share.

I follow Saturne along the white corridor, lined with embossed balustrades, and came to the garden at the rear of the house. In the middle of the garden, just like Saturne said, stands a table, laden with desserts.
After I sit down. Saturne opens the insulating package, takes out one of the still-cold bottles of sparkling orange, and hands me the other.
Saturne doesn't immediately answer, but squints at the small bubbles seething in the bottle.

I have been in One Han City for a long time now, and I don't actually know that much about other cities. There's a saying about how the same orange seed would grow different kinds of fruits in the north and the south. Based on this little knowledge, I think Saturne is probably from someone in the very far, freezing north.

The easy flow of conversation shows that Saturne is more approachable than he first appears, and the afternoon passes quickly. After finishing off the bottle of sparkling orange, I suddenly realize I have tarried too long and better get back to the café. I explain this to Saturne, and he graciously sees me out.

Turning to leave, my gaze happens to fall upon Saturne's bottle of sparkling orange. It looks like he hasn't really drunk much, if any. Being at room temperature for so long, all the fizz is probably already gone, and without that magic it is just a bottle of warm, flat orange soda. It's definitely not gonna taste very nice now.
On the way back, I keep hoping that he won't make complaints about the taste.
I reach out to pat him on the shoulder and cheer him up, but shrink back at the warning glance he shot me. Seriously, how can a man with eyes that sharp be floored by a delivery order?
Luckily, A-37 doesn't seem particularly troubled. He pauses for a moment, then gets up resolutely and heads out to deliver the order.

A-37 hasn't been gone very long when I hear the custom-made wind chimes at the door, and I quickly get up and go to greet the guest. It is a young, handsome woman, whose very bearing and aura would attract every eye wherever she goes.
It isn't peak time, and there aren't many other customers, so I welcomed her in right away.
She clearly doesn't come to cafés very often, showing a surprising amount of curiosity about the decoration, and even the menu.
Eve's striking appearance belies a cheerful, bright personality. She warmly extends her hand to me as she introduces herself.
But it was difficult to say no to Eve, whether as an employee or as myself...
Just when I seem stuck between a rock and a hard place, Hinata finishes clearing a nearby table. She comes over, taps me on the shoulder and whispers something.
I introduce Hinata to Eve, then go to deal with the furry little troublemakers.

I have clearly counted my chickens a little early, however, as after only a short while I see Hinata frantically waving at me. I go back over, only to find that something seems to be wrong with Eve. Her cheeks are flushed, and her eyes dim.
I look at the table and see the coffee cup with two-thirds gone. I have never seen anything like it, and never would have thought this guest's constitution to be so strange.

Additionally, the intoxicated Eve completely shatters the image she'd first presented when she arrived. Now, she's more like a spoiled child, stubbornly holding on to my apron with a petulant expression.
No, most people who neck a whole barrel of wine wouldn't just be dizzy, they'd either be unconscious or in the nearest ICU.
With Eve and Reina's permission, Hinata and I help Eve to the staff lounge, where she can ride out the caffeine.
Eve wakes up quicker than I thought. She seems embarrassed and reluctant to mention the caffeine stupor, hiding behind the door and whispering apologies to me.
Eve seems to have misunderstood something. Just when I'm about to explain, I see her frantically check the time on her phone.
Right when she's about to leave after collecting her things, Eve seems to think of something. She looks back and gives me a happy smile.
Watching Eve's retreating figure, I can't help but say—
Looking over at Hinata who actually said out loud what I thought as well. But she really did seem like a warm summer breeze, busily darting here and there yet leaving a deep impression on us.
I look around carefully, but there are barely any customers in the café at present, so everyone could grab a rare moment of respite.

As if fearing her attitude would bother me, Eve covers her mouth and whispers an explanation. She's totally overthinking things, and maybe doesn't even realize that she herself possesses the same charisma she's talking about—forthright and hard to turn down.
Eve puts her hands far apart on the table, attempting to illustrate distance. I don't really understand, but I can feel that Northland is indeed very far away from One Han City.
She falls silent for a moment, then shakes her head.
So she's here to visit some friends, but it seems she hasn't met up with them yet, so she came to the café alone.

Well, it isn't really any bother. For the next while Eve asks all about what it is like living in the city, the habits and customs, and other things with which I am familiar. Things that are so humdrum and ordinary to us seem to be novel experiences in her eyes, which makes me very curious about Northland.
It's gotta be so different from One Han City in almost all respects.

Eve hangs around the café for over an hour. Before leaving, she says that she hopes to come back to Éternité the very next day, ideally with her friends if they'd managed to meet up. I wonder if Eve's friends are as easy to get on with as she is!
{character:player} Let me handle this delivery. It doesn't seem far, so I should be back in no time.
{character:A-37} I really appreciate your help! Be careful on the way.
{character:A-37} That area... Isn't very safe. I'd suggest getting back here as soon as the delivery's been made, don't hang around.
{character:player} Block C... No. 2... This is the place!
{character:???} Who might you be?
{character:player} Hi! Are you Mr. Saturne?
{character:???} I'm Saturne, but...
{character:player} I'm with Éternité, sir. I've come to deliver your order. We hope you enjoy it.
{character:Saturne} Ah... I seem to recall the delivery person for Éternité was a young lad, pretty tall and with a darker complexion. Did he not come to work today?
{character:player} We have a lot of orders today, so he's taking care of another area.

{character:Saturne} Haha, I see. No wonder Éternité has become a viral hit. Seems there are many others like me, who cannot resist your delicious offerings yet don't wish to stand in line in this heat.
{character:player} It's a great honor for us to be appreciated by everyone.
{character:Saturne} Haha! I believe having staff such as yourself is another secret of Éternité's success! May I, in turn, have the honor of inviting you to enjoy this refreshing beverage?
{character:player} Sir, I'm not sure...
{character:Saturne} My apologies. It was so delightful speaking with you that I forgot my manners. No offense meant. Nevertheless, if possible I would still like to share this with you.

{character:Saturne} I had originally invited another guest, you see, only to receive notice just now that he is unable to come. Alas, it would be a terrible shame if all the delicious nibbles and drinks go to waste.
{character:Saturne} Therefore, if there was even the teeniest possibility, it would be my pleasure to invite you to partake of this fare with me.
Accept the invitation
Saturne
{character:player} I'm very sorry, sir, but the café's rules don't allow us to stay too long with customers.
{character:Saturne} Ah well, that is a pity. I do hope we have the chance to meet again. And should we do, you be sure to accept my invitation then, hmm?
{character:player} Of course.
{character:player} That customer today, Saturne. Does he often order deliveries?
{character:Reina Nanami} Saturne? No, not at all. That peculiar order certainly jumped out at me, and if I recall correctly today is the first time he's placed an order with us.
{character:player} As long as I'm not imposing, I'd be delighted to.
{character:Saturne} Marvelous! Thank you! I trust we shall have a simply splendid afternoon.

{character:Saturne} If I'd known I was going to invite you, I would have prepared some good tea or wine. However, if it wasn't for these two bottles of sparkling orange, I would never have made your acquaintance in the first place! How marvelous life can be!
{character:player} I think the sparkling orange is excellent. It is a specialty of Éternité, after all.

{character:player} Could I ask you something? Seeing as the main attraction of Éternité is the various kinds of coffee, not that many people specifically order the sparkling orange. You must really like it, right?

{character:Saturne} My hometown is very far away and exceedingly cold. We have neither oranges nor this kind of sparkling beverage. Basically, where I live these sorts of things are almost impossible to find so... Perhaps the rarity makes them valuable to me.
{character:player} So are you here in One Han City for business, sir?
{character:Saturne} Ha, you could say that. As a businessman, I'm often in town closing deals. Sometimes negotiations drag on, however, which is why I bought this place as a home away from home.
{character:Saturne} I was seeking peace and quiet when I bought it, but peace and quiet can be so tedious sometimes. That's why I like to entertain people these days.
{character:player} Don't worry, it's just a simple delivery. There's no bad job, just bad workers!
{character:???} Hello! Is there a table free?
{character:player} Certainly. Please, follow me.
{character:???} Um, excuse me... It's my first time coming to this sort of café, so I'm just really curious, but I don't mean anything by it. By the way, I'm Eve Krist. You can call me Eve.
{character:player} Hi, Eve. I'm {var:player_nickname}, I'll serve you today.
{character:Eve Krist} {var:player_nickname}. That's a lovely name. When you have a minute, would you mind accompanying me for a while?
{character:Hinata Takanashi} {var:player_nickname}, if you're busy then I'd be happy to look after this guest. Relax, I'll make sure she gets the absolute best service!
{character:player} Thanks, I appreciate it.

{character:Eve Krist} This person... Looks so familiar, eh... The name's on the tip of my tongue... Don't tell me! I have an excellent memory, I can... Oh, what was it... Stop shaking... Urgh... So dizzy...
{character:Hinata Takanashi} Ahahaha... She seems to be drunk on coffee!
{character:player} Drunk on coffee?

{character:Hinata Takanashi} Boss gave us training on this before. Some people just naturally can't handle caffeine, and have side effects if they drink coffee... To be honest though, I never thought someone would have this severe a reaction—and just after a single cup, too!
{character:player} Eve! Eve?! Are you alright?
{character:Eve Krist} No, not really... I'm so very dizzy, like I drank a whole barrel of wine.
{character:player} ...
{character:Eve Krist} I'm so sorry for all the trouble I caused today.
{character:player} It's fine, just as long as you're okay. We forgot to warn you that some people can have quite strong adverse reactions to caffeine, so it's kind of our fault.

{character:Eve Krist} There's no coffee in Northland, so no cafés, only hotels and inns. I was always under the impression that drinking coffee was the same as drinking wine, which I'm rather good at. I never thought that my tolerance for caffeine would not even handle one full cup!
{character:player} I don't think... That's how it works...
{character:Eve Krist} I'm sorry, but I must go. Please accept my most sincere apologies once more, for any trouble I may have caused you today.
{character:Eve Krist} Nonetheless, I must say the coffee here is really nice. I hope that tomorrow you could choose a few different kinds for me to challenge! I won't be beaten by a single cup again!
{character:Hinata Takanashi} Miss Eve reminds me of a summer's breeze.
Hinata Takanashi
Half an hour later
Two hours later
{character:player} Sure.
{character:Eve Krist} That's great! Uh, I'm not usually this excitable, it's just you have a way about you that puts people at ease. I can't help but be all chatty around you.
{character:player} No worries.

{character:Eve Krist} Actually, this is my first time in One Han City. The sister said that I should talk to locals if I want to get to know the city quickly. When I first started asking you I was terribly nervous, and afraid you might say no.
{character:player} Aww, there's no need for that. I've been in One Han City a long time now, so whatever you want to know I'll do my best to help.

{character:Eve Krist} You seem to really like One Han City, {var:player_nickname}. Well, I suppose you must be in order to know it so well! Like me, I know pretty much all there is to know about Northland, because I really love it there... Oh, I don't suppose you've heard of Northland, have you? It's really very far away from One Han City, after all, pretty much as far north as you can get. It's covered in snow and ice all year round, but is a breathtakingly gorgeous country!
{character:player} Are you here to sight-see, then?
{character:Eve Krist} I'm looking for my best friend... Once I've found her, we'll return to the north together.
{character:player} Well, you'll have to bring her here for a coffee before you head back!
{character:Eve Krist} Of course! I won't just bring her here for coffee, but I'll also tell her how simply wonderful {var:player_nickname} is, and how much you've helped me.
Yet another busy day has flashed by. I've noticed a similarity between the café and the dojo, namely that it's easy to meet all sorts of different people. I wonder if I'll see Eve again tomorrow?
Decline the invitation

Yet another busy day has flashed by. I've discovered that delivering orders is yet another new experience. Over the next few days, if there are more of this kind of nearby deliveries, maybe I could give A-37 a hand?
Eve Krist
I glance awkwardly towards the cat tree where, because A-37 has gone on a delivery, the kittens he'd been looking after are already starting a "rebellion". Someone needs to go and rein them in.

What surprises me is that, although Eve seems to be slender, with a body that most women would die for, she is unexpectedly heavy. Her right arm, draped over me, is not only heavy but also so cold that it doesn't feel like human skin.
Luckily she is still sober enough to walk on her own. If she'd been fully unconscious, Hinata and I might not have been able to get her into the staff room at all.
